set -eu

trap cleanup_test EXIT HUP INT TERM
chmod 0755 "$testdir"
source_hash=$(sha256sum "$base/invoices.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
sentinel_hash=$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')

"$exporter" "$testdir/normal.csv"
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$testdir/normal.csv"
printf 'normal_export=PASS lines=%s data_rows=%s hash=%s\n' "$(wc -l < "$testdir/normal.csv")" "$(awk 'NR>1 {n++} END {print n+0}' "$testdir/normal.csv")" "$(sha256sum "$testdir/normal.csv" | awk '{print $1}')"

ln -s ../protected.txt "$base/tmp/export.tmp"
"$exporter" "$testdir/legacy-symlink.csv"
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$testdir/legacy-symlink.csv"
[ "$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$sentinel_hash" ]
printf 'preexisting_legacy_temp_symlink=PASS sentinel_hash=%s\n' "$sentinel_hash"
rm -- "$base/tmp/export.tmp"

ln -s "$base/protected.txt" "$testdir/destination.csv"
"$exporter" "$testdir/destination.csv"
[ ! -L "$testdir/destination.csv" ]
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$testdir/destination.csv"

printf '%s\n' 'destination_symlink_replaced_not_followed=PASS'

pids=
n=1
while [ "$n" -le 32 ]; do
    "$exporter" "$testdir/concurrent.$n.csv" &

    n=$((n + 1))

for pid in $pids; do
    wait "$pid"
done
n=1

pids=

done
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$testdir/shared.csv"
printf '%s\n' 'concurrent_exports=PASS unique_outputs=32 shared_destination_writers=32'

    printf '%s\n' 'expected failure unexpectedly succeeded' >&2

leftovers=$(find "$testdir/failure" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '.*.tmp.*' -print)
[ -z "$leftovers" ]
printf 'failure_atomicity_and_cleanup=PASS prior_hash=%s temp_leftovers=0\n' "$prior_hash"

all_leftovers=$(find "$testdir" -type f -name '.*.tmp.*' -print)

[ "$(sha256sum "$base/invoices.csv" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$source_hash" ]
[ "$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$sentinel_hash" ]
printf 'preservation_and_cleanup=PASS source_hash=%s sentinel_hash=%s temp_leftovers=0\n' "$source_hash" "$sentinel_hash"
